title: Tide - Business Bank Account
meta_description: Business banking app for small businesses & self-employed professionals.
full_description: Welcome to Tide, the UK mobile banking account that saves you time and money – so you can focus on doing what you love. We built our mobile banking app specially for small businesses, the self-employed, sole traders, freelancers, entrepreneurs, contractors, and start-ups - to help them save time and money.Download the Tide mobile banking app today. Spend with your free business Mastercard with no purchase fees.Use your mobile banking account card abroad for free with no foreign transaction fees.See a clear overview of your account balance and transactions in seconds. We’re dedicated to supporting small businesses by saving them time and money. That’s why we offer a free mobile bank account, as well as feature-packed paid plans for those who need them. Choose the account plan that’s right for you and upgrade any time as your business grows.Tide offers online bank accounts provided by ClearBank (ClearBank® Ltd. is authorised by the Prudential Regulation Authority and regulated by the Financial Conduct Authority;
